PLAN "12-Week Pregnancy Strength Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and safe progression through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower/Total-Body (trimester1)":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          db_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper/Core Stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20..40 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Glute/Hamstring Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

NOTES:
- Avoid supine positions after week 16; program uses exercises that can be performed upright or seated when needed.
- No max attempts; all sets are submaximal with RPE targets.
- Pressure-free progression; emphasize technique, breath control, and comfort.
- If any exercise causes discomfort, substitute with a safe alternative from the same muscle group (e.g., replace bench_press with incline_press or push_up with incline_push_up if needed).
- Pregnancy-safe core work: include pallof_press and side_plank with careful breathing; avoid lying abdominal flexion-heavy routines after mid-pregnancy if advised by clinician.
- Maintain hydration, task-specific modifications as gestational age advances, and consulting OB if any new symptoms arise.
